dialogues.jp:
日曜日の校内はいたってのどかだ。遠くの方か
ら、微かに運動部の掛け声が聞こえてくるのみ。
dialogues.en:
Unsurprisingly, there isn't many people in school on a
Sunday. I could hear the faint voices of the exercise club
in the distance.
dialogues.text:
Unsurprisingly, there isn't many people in school on a
Sunday. I could hear the faint voices of the exercise club
in the distance.

dialogues.jp:
２月の空気は冷たい。誰もいない校舎には当然
のように熱気がなく、勝手に身体がブルブル震
えてしまう。
dialogues.en:
The Feburary weather is cold. Couple that with the school
not switching on the heaters on Sunday... no wonder that I'm
shivering.
dialogues.text:
The Feburary weather is cold. Couple that with the school
not switching on the heaters on Sunday... no wonder that I'm
shivering.

dialogues.jp:
コツコツ、と足音が、廊下だけでなく身体の芯
にも響き渡る。
dialogues.en: My footsteps resounded down the empty corridor as I walked.
dialogues.text: My footsteps resounded down the empty corridor as I walked.

dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……なんで俺はここにいるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Haa... why did I come here in the first place?"
dialogues.text: "Haa... why did I come here in the first place?"

dialogues.jp: 『俺に会いにきたのだろう？』
dialogues.en: "To meet me, perhaps?"
dialogues.text: "To meet me, perhaps?"

dialogues.jp:
そんな声に振り返ると、不敵な笑みを浮かべた
男……名前も思い出したくもない……が立って
いた。
dialogues.en:
I turned my head to the sound of the voice behind me.
Standing there was a smiling male, whose name was alien to
me.
dialogues.text:
I turned my head to the sound of the voice behind me.
Standing there was a smiling male, whose name was alien to
me.

dialogues.jp: 「あぁ。で、貴方は誰ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Ahh. Then who are you?'
dialogues.text: "Ahh. Then who are you?'

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「Ｙｏｕｒ　ｅｍｐｅｒｏｒ」
dialogues.en: "Your emperor."
dialogues.text: "Your emperor."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんでお前が俺の皇帝なんだ」
dialogues.en: "Since when did you become my emperor, huh."
dialogues.text: "Since when did you become my emperor, huh."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、思い出したか」
dialogues.en: "I see, you remember now."
dialogues.text: "I see, you remember now."

dialogues.jp: こいつは……。
dialogues.en: This guy...
dialogues.text: This guy...

dialogues.jp:
「で、なんでお前がここにいるんだ？　しかも、
　学生服で」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, what are you doing here? In your school uniform, no
less."
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, what are you doing here? In your school uniform, no
less."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なに、人がいない方が何かと動きやすくてな」
dialogues.en: "Monitoring the hallways, of course."
dialogues.text: "Monitoring the hallways, of course."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そして、黒い服装は人目を忍びやすい」
dialogues.en:
"And my school uniform makes me that much more stealthy
while performing my work."
dialogues.text:
"And my school uniform makes me that much more stealthy
while performing my work."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「では、俺はそろそろ任務に戻るとしよう」
dialogues.en: "If that explains enough, I'd return to my duty."
dialogues.text: "If that explains enough, I'd return to my duty."

dialogues.jp:
オメガバカが、奇妙に膨れた鞄を手に、教員棟
のほうへと消えていく。
dialogues.en:
The omega idiot, carrying a strangely bulging bag, quickly
disappeared into the teacher's room.
dialogues.text:
The omega idiot, carrying a strangely bulging bag, quickly
disappeared into the teacher's room.

dialogues.jp:
授業もないのに、いったい何が詰まっているん
だか……。
dialogues.en: There aren't any lessons now, so what the hell is he doing?
dialogues.text: There aren't any lessons now, so what the hell is he doing?

dialogues.jp: 「あまり深くは考えまい」
dialogues.en: "I shouldn't think too much about this."
dialogues.text: "I shouldn't think too much about this."

dialogues.jp:
杉並のことは忘れることにして、俺も学園内を
｛はいかい／徘徊｝する。
dialogues.en:
Forgetting about Suginami's affairs, I continue wandering
the school grounds.
dialogues.text:
Forgetting about Suginami's affairs, I continue wandering
the school grounds.

dialogues.jp: 「つまらん」
dialogues.en: "Booooring..."
dialogues.text: "Booooring..."

dialogues.jp:
そもそも、学園の内部なんか見飽きているのに、
なんで散策なんかしてるんだ？
dialogues.en:
I already spend six days a week staring at the school's
interior, why did I come here for the seventh again?
dialogues.text:
I already spend six days a week staring at the school's
interior, why did I come here for the seventh again?

dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp: 音楽室の扉の前で立ち止まる。
dialogues.en: I stop at the entrance to the music room.
dialogues.text: I stop at the entrance to the music room.

dialogues.jp: 微かに、人の声が聞こえた気がした。
dialogues.en: I can hear faint voices coming from inside.
dialogues.text: I can hear faint voices coming from inside.

dialogues.jp: ドアに耳を当て、息を潜める。
dialogues.en: I place my ear on the door and silence my breathing.
dialogues.text: I place my ear on the door and silence my breathing.

dialogues.jp: なにも聞こえない。
dialogues.en: The only thing that graces my ears is a deathly silence.
dialogues.text: The only thing that graces my ears is a deathly silence.

dialogues.jp:
もっとも音楽室の音が外に漏れるようでは、造
りに問題ありだが。
dialogues.en:
I suppose it's a fair problem if any sound could escape from
a music room.
dialogues.text:
I suppose it's a fair problem if any sound could escape from
a music room.

dialogues.jp:
「自分で言うのもなんだが……むちゃくちゃ怪
　しげだよな、今の俺」
dialogues.en: "...I bet I look pretty suspicious too."
dialogues.text: "...I bet I look pretty suspicious too."

dialogues.jp:
それでも止めないのは、休日で誰かが通りかか
ることがないのと、なにより退屈だったから。
dialogues.en:
But I didn't feel like stopping. Besides, on a rest day at
school, there's not much else to do, and no one to see me
anyway.
dialogues.text:
But I didn't feel like stopping. Besides, on a rest day at
school, there's not much else to do, and no one to see me
anyway.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、暇つぶしにはなったか……」
dialogues.en: "...Guess I'm wasting my time."
dialogues.text: "...Guess I'm wasting my time."

dialogues.jp: 誰もいるわけがない――。
dialogues.en: Looks like no one's in there--
dialogues.text: Looks like no one's in there--

dialogues.jp: 「違うってば！　そうじゃなくて、こうッ！」
dialogues.en: "No, wrong! That's not how it's supposed to be, geez!"
dialogues.text: "No, wrong! That's not how it's supposed to be, geez!"

dialogues.jp: なんと……まさか本当に人がいたとは……。
dialogues.en: Well... guess there are people inside...
dialogues.text: Well... guess there are people inside...

dialogues.jp:
「……にしても、なんだか聞き覚えのある声の
　ような？」
dialogues.en: "...And why does that voice sound so familiar?"
dialogues.text: "...And why does that voice sound so familiar?"

dialogues.jp: 無意識に手がドアノブに伸びる――。
dialogues.en: I unconciously put my hand on the doorknob.
dialogues.text: I unconciously put my hand on the doorknob.

dialogues.jp: どうりで聞き覚えがあるわけだ。
dialogues.en: The truth was that I do know the owner of that voice.
dialogues.text: The truth was that I do know the owner of that voice.

dialogues.jp:
音楽部の練習――にしては、他に人がいないみ
たいだな。
dialogues.en:
It looked like a music club practice session-- except there
were only two people inside.
dialogues.text:
It looked like a music club practice session-- except there
were only two people inside.

dialogues.jp:
中では、萌先輩と眞子が楽しげに楽器を鳴らし
ている。
dialogues.en:
Inside, Moe-senpai and Mako were happily playing their
instruments.
dialogues.text:
Inside, Moe-senpai and Mako were happily playing their
instruments.

dialogues.jp:
ふたりとも目を閉じて、自分の音楽の世界に浸っ
ている感じだ。
dialogues.en:
Both of them had their eyes closed, lost in a world of their
own.
dialogues.text:
Both of them had their eyes closed, lost in a world of their
own.

dialogues.jp:
さすがは姉妹だけあって、息はピッタリと言っ
たところか。
dialogues.en:
As can be expected from sisters, their rhythm was in exact
synchronization.
dialogues.text:
As can be expected from sisters, their rhythm was in exact
synchronization.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、眞子はともかく、萌先輩の木琴のほうの
音は……。
dialogues.en:
Mako was playing as normal as a flute can get, but
Moe-senpai's xylophone playing was somehow...
dialogues.text:
Mako was playing as normal as a flute can get, but
Moe-senpai's xylophone playing was somehow...

dialogues.jp: （微妙だ）
dialogues.en: "(Subtle...)"
dialogues.text: "(Subtle...)"

dialogues.jp:
上手い下手は別にして、流れてくる音色からは、
ふたりの楽しげな気持ちが感じられた。
dialogues.en:
It wasn't a case of being skilled or unskilled here. From
the flowing music, the whimsical mood of the two could be
felt.
dialogues.text:
It wasn't a case of being skilled or unskilled here. From
the flowing music, the whimsical mood of the two could be
felt.

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩たのしそう……って、あれ？
dialogues.en: Moe-senpai especially looked like she was...ehh?
dialogues.text: Moe-senpai especially looked like she was...ehh?

dialogues.jp: のりのりになった萌先輩の音がさらにぶっ飛ぶ。
dialogues.en:
All of a sudden, Moe-senpai's music flew up in terms of
power.
dialogues.text:
All of a sudden, Moe-senpai's music flew up in terms of
power.

dialogues.jp: このはずし方は……凄い。
dialogues.en: The sudden change in tempo... amazing.
dialogues.text: The sudden change in tempo... amazing.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっとお姉ちゃん！　また音が外れてる！」
dialogues.en: "Wait, onee-chan! You fell out of sync again!"
dialogues.text: "Wait, onee-chan! You fell out of sync again!"

dialogues.jp: 眞子が口元からフルートを離し、叱責する。
dialogues.en: Mako removed her mouth from her flute to rebuke her sister.
dialogues.text: Mako removed her mouth from her flute to rebuke her sister.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.jp: 不思議そうに、萌先輩が手の動きを止める。
dialogues.en: With a perplexed expression, Moe's hands stopped moving.
dialogues.text: With a perplexed expression, Moe's hands stopped moving.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「“え？”じゃなくて、またズレてるの」
dialogues.en: "Don't just say "Eh?". You slid off there."
dialogues.text: "Don't just say "Eh?". You slid off there."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんなさい」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry."

dialogues.jp:
しゅんとして謝る萌先輩。その姿につい保護し
たくなる。
dialogues.en:
Moe-senpai apologized deeply. Her demeanour made her seem
more like a caretaker or guardian.
dialogues.text:
Moe-senpai apologized deeply. Her demeanour made her seem
more like a caretaker or guardian.

dialogues.jp:
「まあ、いいじゃんか。楽しく演奏できればそ
　れで」
dialogues.en: "Aw, it was fine. I thought it was a great performance."
dialogues.text: "Aw, it was fine. I thought it was a great performance."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「えっ」
dialogues.en: "Ah!"
dialogues.text: "Ah!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉……いつの間に……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura... how long were you here..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura... how long were you here..."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「いつの間にか」
dialogues.en: "The whole time."
dialogues.text: "The whole time."

dialogues.jp: 気のせいか、眞子から殺気を感じる。
dialogues.en: I could feel Mako's bloodthirst growing.
dialogues.text: I could feel Mako's bloodthirst growing.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あ、こんにちは朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Ah, good afternoon, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Ah, good afternoon, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩だけは、にこやかに微笑んで迎えいれて
くれる。
dialogues.en:
In direct contrast, Moe-senpai's greeting was delivered with
a pleasant smile.
dialogues.text:
In direct contrast, Moe-senpai's greeting was delivered with
a pleasant smile.

dialogues.jp: 「どうも」
dialogues.en: "Good afternoon to you too."
dialogues.text: "Good afternoon to you too."

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩に挨拶しつつ、眞子との距離を保つ。
dialogues.en: I greeted Moe-senpai, and kept a safe distance from Mako.
dialogues.text: I greeted Moe-senpai, and kept a safe distance from Mako.

dialogues.jp: 「ふたりだけでなにやってるんです？」
dialogues.en: "So, what are you two doing?"
dialogues.text: "So, what are you two doing?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「えーと、楽器の練習です」
dialogues.en: "Uhmmm, we're practicing our music."
dialogues.text: "Uhmmm, we're practicing our music."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いや、それは見れば分かります。ええ」
dialogues.en: "No, I can see that, I mean..."
dialogues.text: "No, I can see that, I mean..."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「４月の入学式のときに演奏する曲の練習」
dialogues.en:
"We're practicing the performance for the opening ceremony
in April."
dialogues.text:
"We're practicing the performance for the opening ceremony
in April."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、うちらの入学式か。音楽部がやるんだ
　よな。お前もなんか吹くのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, the opening ceremony for high-school... not
unsurprising that the music club would perform there. You'd
be playing your flute?
dialogues.text:
"Ah, the opening ceremony for high-school... not
unsurprising that the music club would perform there. You'd
be playing your flute?

dialogues.jp: もぅ、そんな時期なんだなと感心する。
dialogues.en:
If nothing else, I definitely admire Mako for her musical
skills.
dialogues.text:
If nothing else, I definitely admire Mako for her musical
skills.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「｛あたし／新入生｝が吹いてどうするのよ。お姉ちゃんの
　練習をみてんの」
dialogues.en:
"What would a freshman like me be doing playing there? I'm
just watching over my sister practicing."
dialogues.text:
"What would a freshman like me be doing playing there? I'm
just watching over my sister practicing."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩がでるの？」
dialogues.en: "Moe-senpai will be playing then?"
dialogues.text: "Moe-senpai will be playing then?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp: 本人は一抹の不安も感じてなさそうな笑顔。
dialogues.en:
A tinge of anxiety marked her words and smile as she
answered my question.
dialogues.text:
A tinge of anxiety marked her words and smile as she
answered my question.

dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫なのか？」
dialogues.en: "Will it be okay?"
dialogues.text: "Will it be okay?"

dialogues.jp: 聞いた人間は不安で仕方がない。
dialogues.en:
It's pretty understandable to be a bit nervous in that
situation.
dialogues.text:
It's pretty understandable to be a bit nervous in that
situation.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「まあ……あと１ヶ月ちょいあるし」
dialogues.en: "Well... there's still a month to practice."
dialogues.text: "Well... there's still a month to practice."

dialogues.jp: “大丈夫”とは言わないんだな……。
dialogues.en: She didn't answer "yes", huh...
dialogues.text: She didn't answer "yes", huh...

dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩、がんばってくださいね」
dialogues.en: "Moe-senpai, I'd be rooting for you."
dialogues.text: "Moe-senpai, I'd be rooting for you."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「はい。ありがとうございます。当日は、真心
　を込めて歓迎しますね」
dialogues.en:
"Yes, thank you very much. On the day, I'd put all my heart
into welcoming you and Mako."
dialogues.text:
"Yes, thank you very much. On the day, I'd put all my heart
into welcoming you and Mako."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「お願いします」
dialogues.en: "Please do."
dialogues.text: "Please do."

dialogues.jp:
俺の言葉に、萌先輩と眞子が顔を見合わせて、
微笑む。
dialogues.en:
At my words, Moe-senpai and Mako both exchanged glances and
smiles.
dialogues.text:
At my words, Moe-senpai and Mako both exchanged glances and
smiles.

dialogues.jp: 「それじゃあ、がんばってください」
dialogues.en: "Well then, do your best till then."
dialogues.text: "Well then, do your best till then."

dialogues.jp: 防音加工の扉を開け、廊下にでる。
dialogues.en: I go out the soundproofed door, back into the corridor.
dialogues.text: I go out the soundproofed door, back into the corridor.

dialogues.jp: そういや、よく眞子の声が外に漏れたよな……。
dialogues.en:
...Speaking of which, amazing that Mako's voice could pierce
through this "barrier"...
dialogues.text:
...Speaking of which, amazing that Mako's voice could pierce
through this "barrier"...

dialogues.jp: ◆音楽室の個人指導◆
dialogues.en: ◆Private Tution in the Music Room◆
dialogues.text: ◆Private Tution in the Music Room◆

dialogues.jp:
日曜の音楽室で眞子と萌先輩を見つけた。なん
でも新入生歓迎会で演奏する曲の練習らしい。
dialogues.en:
I saw Moe-senpai and Mako in the music room on Sunday. They
were practicing a piece for the freshmen welcoming
reception.
dialogues.text:
I saw Moe-senpai and Mako in the music room on Sunday. They
were practicing a piece for the freshmen welcoming
reception.

dialogues.jp:
楽しげに演奏しているのはいいのだけど……先
輩の音のはずし方は神域に突入していた。
dialogues.en:
I felt that the performance was good, but apparently Moe's
playing was a bit rushed.
dialogues.text:
I felt that the performance was good, but apparently Moe's
playing was a bit rushed.

dialogues.jp:
ちなみに、これより前に杉並に会ったことは忘
れるとしよう。
dialogues.en:
On another note, I completely forgot about Suginami's
affairs earlier.
dialogues.text:
On another note, I completely forgot about Suginami's
affairs earlier.
